SASBDB entry SASD2P2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASD2P2/)

Chondroitin sulfate 8-mer (glycan alone, NOT a CXCL8 complex), in-house SAXS, 50 mM sodium
phosphate pH 7.0 + 100 mM NaCl (paper, Suppl. Table 1; SASBDB lists only the phosphate), 5 C.
Publication: White MA et al., Biochem J 2026, DOI 10.1042/BCJ20260348 (read 2026-11-13).
Files:
  experimental_data/SASD2P2.dat    SASBDB intensities file (q in A^-1)
  SASD2P2_fit1.fit                 SASBDB fitting file (CRYSOL, q in A^-1; chi2 0.899)
  SASD2P2_fit1_model1.pdb          SASBDB model (CHARMM, 197 atoms with hydrogens), UNCHANGED.
                                   Residue names 4ZB/VVB/6VB/SO3 collide with unrelated
                                   wwPDB components; read statically in the round-6 audit: the ATOM records
                                   load by element (120 heavy atoms), the 77 hydrogens are dropped
                                   by the canonical copy. Not run.
